title: Weierstrass preparation over a complete local ring
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$, complete for its $\mathfrak m$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $F\in B[[T]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series] have nonzero coefficientwise image in $(B/\mathfrak m)[[T]]$. There exist $u\in B[[T]]^\times$, an integer $n\geq0$, and a monic polynomial $P=T^n+\sum_{i<n}b_iT^i\in B[T]$ with all $b_i\in\mathfrak m$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], such that $F=uP$.
